**OPNduck v0.5.3-Beta** 🦆

**New**
• OPNduck TUI: the tools in a terminal, ~100 MB of memory, 26 themes, shares settings with the desktop app
• First-launch setup wizard for the downloader, video engine, Audio AI and Subtitles
• Developer-tool channels now require Developer mode

Beta: expect bugs. Windows installers untested on real Windows. Tauri still postponed (WebKitGTK stutters/crashes with NVIDIA + Wayland).
